verdict.rationale: Sentry's first-party docs show traces of end-to-end agent runs that follow execution across model calls, tools and services, with an AI Spans view and agent handoffs. Related AI spans are grouped into conversations via `gen_ai.conversation.id` / `set_conversation_id()`, and a Conversations view replays multi-turn sessions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the parent/child span nesting hierarchy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: **Traces** shows end-to-end agent runs and the application work around them.
Use it to follow execution across model calls, tools, and services or to investigate latency and errors in context.
Sentry uses the `gen_ai.conversation.id` attribute to group related AI spans, and some SDK integrations set it automatically.
Use `set_conversation_id()` so every AI span in a chat session shares the same `gen_ai.conversation.id`.
Use it to replay a user's multi-turn interaction, inspect its transcript and timeline, and find where a response or tool call went wrong.
